# Secure development

Read the [baseline](references/core.instructions.md) before proposing implementation changes. Preserve intended behavior and the project's established architecture.

Use the [module index](references/modules.json) to identify guidance for the files and trust boundaries involved in the task. Each entry contains the original `applyTo` patterns and a path relative to this skill. Read the matching references before making security-sensitive changes. Multiple language, framework, and cross-cutting modules can apply to the same file.

In VS Code, native rules also apply by file pattern. In clients that select skills by description, use this index explicitly; loading the skill does not itself attach every matching reference.

Apply the guidance to the requested implementation. A deeper security review requires an explicit user request and the Secure Code Review agent. This skill does not grant tools or run commands.
